verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a framework's tooling, but nothing in the evidence shows Angular accepting natural-language commands. The CLI documents only conventional subcommands. The AI material (AI-forward resources, a prompts section, llms.txt) helps users work with external AI tools rather than letting Angular itself be driven by natural language, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
